routes.name: East Couloir
routes.approach: Start at the Horse Creek trailhead behind the Mono Village resort at Twin Lakes and follow the Horse Creek Trail up the drainage and through the meadows. Where the trail climbs to a shallow col, leave it for a use trail up the ridge east of the glacier drainage to a small lake just under 10,000 feet, which has several campsites. routes.name: Southwest Ridge via Tombstone Pass
routes.description: Follow Tombstone Creek to Tombstone Pass, traverse to the cirque below the summit and climb the southwest ridge to the summit block. The block itself is a short 5.4 crack on the south side. Class 2 to the summit block, which is Class 4.

routes.name: Standard Route - south slopes
routes.approach: The usual way in is from the Horseshoe Meadows trailhead, west on the Cottonwood Lakes trail past the lakes and up switchbacks to New Army Pass at about 12,300 feet. Long Lake is a common overnight camp. The trail beyond the pass heads on toward Rock Creek, so leave it there and turn right across the open, sandy ground to Langley's south slopes.
